build_UNITER_for_classification: build a UNITER model for image-text classification tasks with configurable heads and loss functions
build_UNITER_for_pretraining: build a UNITER model for pretraining with MLM, ITM, MRC, MRFR, and WRA tasks
create_UNITERImageEmbeddings: create image embeddings by projecting and normalizing image features and position features through linear layers
create_UNITERModelBase: create a UNITER base model combining BERT text embeddings with image embeddings and a transformer encoder
review_UNITER_add_custom_params: review the UNITER add_custom_params method that computes image masks, attention masks, and position features from sample lists
